thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - host gpu-n2-rack7-host03 lost heartbeat. Reason: node-unresponsive. Potential kernel panic detected by host-monitor. Incident ID INC-4518.

pagerduty: Page fired to schedule: sre-oncall-primary -> ben_sre. Escalation if not acked in 2m.

Ben (oncall): ack. I'm on it. First check: can anyone confirm recent deploys to rack7? @Dave (prod-eng)

Dave (prod-eng): no deploys to that rack in the last 6h. CI/CD shows no failures.

Ben (oncall): ok. Carla, can you pull host telemetry and kernel logs (journalctl -k) for gpu-n2-rack7-host03?

Carla (infra): grabbing logs now. Host heartbeat dropped at ~18:12 UTC. Last kernel oops shows: "kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference" + stack trace referencing nvidia.

Carla (infra): attaching excerpt: ```kernel: [    612.345678] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=0, Graphics Engine: ACPI GES 0x00, reason: GPU has fallen off the bus```. Looks like GPU driver/hardware hard fault -> kernel panic -> host went unresponsive.

Ben (oncall): that aligns with host-monitor. Kubelet moved node to NotReady shortly after. We need to minimize customer impact. Begin cordon+drain for that node if any pods still show. Carla, are pods still listed?

Carla (infra): K8s shows node NotReady and unschedulable. Some pods were left in Terminating state due to kubelet lost connection. I'm forcing evacuation: `kubectl drain gpu-n2-rack7-host03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`.

Alice (SRE): adding checklist: 1) This host is part of Dedicated pool for eu-west-1-c; 2) Affected customers are on Dedicated and overflow routing to fallback models should be active. 3) Check LU (latency) and 5xx rates.

Eve (support): Monitoring dashboard: We see a spike in 503 errors for customers CUST-228 and CUST-312 starting at 18:13 UTC. Incidents page shows increased latency on /v1/generate for eu-west-1-c. Raising customer pager for CUST-312 (they're on enterprise SLA).

Ben (oncall): Thanks. Immediate mitigations: a) force drain done; b) ensure fallback routing is in effect for requests to that pool; c) spin up replacement host or move capacity from spare pool. Carla, can you trigger autoscale for dedicated-eu-west-1-c fallback nodes?

Carla (infra): K8s autoscaler policy invoked: scaled dedicated-eu-west-1-c-pool from 6 -> 9 nodes. New nodes provisioning now. Also manually created a replacement host request with infra-provisioner: `provision host-type=gpu-a10 location=eu-west-1-c tags=rack7-replacement`. ETA ~ 12 min.

Dave (prod-eng): Routing: I'm enabling model fallback for the affected model family to the quantized variant to reduce per-token load. Pushing routing change now (canary to 10% -> 50%).

Ben (oncall): Good. Alice, validate traffic and SLO impact.

Alice (SRE): Looking at tracing/metrics: request volume for pool dropped by 40% due to failover, and 5xx rate reduced from 6% -> 1.2% after autoscale + fallback. Latency increased ~80ms median on fallback, acceptable under SLA. Keeping eyes on error budgets.

Eve (support): Notifying CUST-312: "We've detected a host failure in eu-west-1-c affecting some Dedicated capacity. We've routed traffic to fallback capacity and scaled up; mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30 min."

Ben (oncall): PagerDuty: leave incident open. I'm going to attempt to recover kernel logs and capture the host image for postmortem. Carla, can we snapshot /var/log/journal and export dmesg?

Carla (infra): Copying logs to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-4518/ and creating host snapshot. Also marking host for hardware replacement.

Ben (oncall): Kubelet is showing `csi driver` errors due to abrupt removal; recreating affected pods completed at 18:28 UTC. Some stateful pods required manual PVC reattachment; that completed.

Alice (SRE): Confirming node is cordoned and drained. New nodes joined and started accepting pods at 18:35 UTC. 99% of pods rescheduled. A small batch of GPU long-running training jobs were lost — notified owners.

Eve (support): CUST-312 acknowledges update and asked for ETA on full restoration of Dedicated capacity. I said ~30 mins for replacement host and 1h for hardware swap if needed.

Ben (oncall): PagerDuty: creating follow-up ticket PD-4518-rca for infra and driver team. Immediate owners: Carla (infra) and Dave (prod-eng).

Carla (infra): I'll run stress tests on replacement host and check driver versions. Quick note: host firmware on rack7 is behind by 2 versions; scheduling fleet firmware update after replacement.

Dave (prod-eng): We'll add guarded restart to driver load path to avoid full kernel OOPS on next failure. Also adding tighter LKML error detection to failover faster.

Ben (oncall): Handoff: I'm at +45m into page; need to hand to night SRE. @Alice (SRE) — can you take watch and follow up on customer comms and RCA tracking? I'll write up the initial timeline.

Alice (SRE): Taking over. Summary for handoff: host gpu-n2-rack7-host03 kernel panic -> lost heartbeat -> kubelet NotReady -> drain & autoscale -> fallback routing & quantized model routing -> replacements provisioned -> pods rescheduled -> partial customer impact (CUST-228, CUST-312). Next actions: infra to collect full host dump, driver team to triage Xid 79, prod-eng to tune fallback routing.

Ben (oncall): Thanks. I'm marking my oncall ack cleared and reassigning incident on PagerDuty to Alice.

pagerduty: Ben (oncall) acknowledged. Incident reassigned to Alice (SRE).

Alice (SRE): I'll keep this incident open until we have the host dump and a driver triage summary. Estimated next update in 2h.

Carla (infra): Host imaging + logs uploaded. Snapshot link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-incident-logs/INC-4518/host03-logs.tar.gz

Dave (prod-eng): Created PR to add guarded driver reload + small routing tweak: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/routing/pull/4523

Eve (support): Customer comms follow-up scheduled for +1h. Will flag if any SLA credit inquiries.

Alice (SRE): last check: cluster eu-west-1-c back to normal pod scheduling, 5xx rates stable. Keeping incident open for RCA artifacts. Closing timeline notes here."
